title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire in the Atlántida, Choluteca, Colón, Francisco Morazán, Intibucá, La Paz, Santa Bárbara, Valle and Yoro districts of Honduras, contributes to outcome 1.1 Duty-bearers have taken actions to respect and protect rights. The objective is that at-risk women and men and their defenders, especially women and women access to justice defenders, take action to claim and defend rights. Activities include capacity building of women access to justice defenders; participation in dialogues with local authorities; and monitoring and analysis of public policy/law that affect resource rights. The programme is in partnership with CEJIL, COPINH, COFADEH, ADEPZA, CEHPRODEC, CESPAD, CNTC La Paz, ERIC, MADJ, and FSAR. ---- The principal focus of this outcome is:- Advocacy for the protection of human rights; in particular natural resource rights- Work under this outcome has a specific focus on women and women human rights defenders
